title: 第3章 鸿门宴会
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

鸿门宴是中国历史上最著名、影响最大的饭局，没有之一，因为它已经成为了现实生活中“挖坑埋人”的代名词。我们今天用“鸿门宴”去借喻那些惊险局是没有问题的，但是如果回到事件当时，项羽真的是要杀刘邦吗？

《史记》记载：【项伯许诺，谓沛公曰：“旦日不可不蚤自来谢项王。”沛公曰：“诺。”于是项伯复夜去，至军中，具以沛公言报项王，因言曰：“沛公不先破关中，公岂敢入乎？今人有大功而击之，不义也。不如因善遇之。”项王许诺。沛公旦日从百余骑来见项王，至鸿门，谢曰：“臣与将军戮力而攻秦，将军战河北，臣战河南，不自意能先入关破秦，得复见将军于此。今者有小人之言，令将军与臣有郤。”项王曰：“此沛公左司马曹无伤言之。不然，籍何以至此？”】

也就是说，第二天一大早，鸡还没叫，刘邦早早起床，带着一百多名保镖到鸿门面见项羽。

一见面，刘邦就向项羽道歉：“我跟将军合力攻秦，将军在黄河以北作战，我在黄河以南打辅助。我也没想到自己走了狗屎运，竟然先入关灭了秦朝，又在这里见到了您。听说您对我有点误会，准是有小人挑拨离间，您可千万别轻信啊。”

仔细回味，刘邦的这番话可谓是意味深长，王立群教授曾把刘邦的这段话称为“鸿门说辞”。

首先，刘邦强调了自己和项羽的战友情，消除了项羽对自己的敌意，表明自己和项羽，同为反秦起义的两大主力军，两人属于同盟关系。

其次，刘邦否认了自己抢先入关、想当关中王的意图，解释自己是偶然进入关中，把必然事件改成偶然事件，所以不存在所谓的“欲王关中”的流言。

既然当初义帝定下盟约：“先入关中为王。”我刘邦都没有“欲王关中”的企图，反倒是等您来接收。那么项羽还如此整顿兵马大动干戈就有点下不来台面了。不过没关系，因为刘邦早就为项羽找好了台阶，“今有小人从中挑拨”，破坏我和将军您之间的团结。总之一句话：误会，全都是误会啊。

刘邦把话说得不卑不亢，逢迎中又带点委屈。话既然说到了这里，项羽就不得不表态了，他对刘邦说：“可不是嘛，这都是你手下的曹无伤说的，要不我也不会生这么大气。好了，都过去了，一块进去喝酒吧。”

从这里可以看出项羽确实是非常好面子的，我现在已经是灭秦领袖了，是天下第一大英雄，作为老大，如果是非不分，遇事不明，岂不是让天下诸侯看清我？认为我既不仁义，又没有政治智慧。于是，轻飘飘一句话就把曹无伤给卖了。

在项羽眼中，曹无伤不过是一个不忠不义的小人，这种人成事不足败事有余，完全没有保护他的必要。

但这个解释实在没有必要，此时的项羽拥兵40万，正是他人生最辉煌的时候，面对刘邦的乞求，完全可以付之一笑，继续拿捏刘邦，毕竟彪悍的人生不需要解释。可是项羽却总觉得面子上挂不住，竟然认真解释了。这一解释，项羽就已经落了下风。

大帐内，各人座次分明。项羽是主人，和项伯面朝东坐；范增面阴南坐；刘邦是客人，面朝北坐；张良面朝西陪侍着。帐内众人各怀心思。

张良没有喝酒，默默注视着项羽的一举一动。范增眯着眼，盯着对面的刘邦。刘邦明显感觉到了范增身上散发出的那股强烈杀气。不过他表现得很从容，屡屡举杯向坐在西侧的项羽敬酒，回忆着两人并肩战斗的革命光辉岁月。

项羽的面容有些冷峻，一张凛凛生威的国字脸上，两道浓眉下，一双虎目精光闪闪，气势凛冽，不怒而威。面对刘邦的股勤致意，项羽有一搭没一搭地回复着刘邦的吹捧和赞扬，眉头紧锁，脸上阴晴不定。

范增一看项羽这架势，那语气、那眼神，没有杀机啊，合着我之前的话都白说了？这可不行！必须要提醒项羽干掉刘邦。范增一个劲向项羽使眼色，看他没反应，又举起身上佩戴的玉玦向他示意。

项羽什么反应？他假装没看见。

范增心中一股怒意升上来，暗想：“刘邦一定不能活着离开这里！既然项王这么优柔寡断、心存妇人之仁要放过刘邦，那就让我来做这个坏人吧。”

Page (1/3)

The Hongmen Banquet is the most famous and influential dinner party in Chinese history, because it has become synonymous with "digging holes and burying people" in real life.It is no problem for us to use "Hongmen Banquet" as a metaphor for those thrilling situations today, but if we go back to the time of the incident, did Xiang Yu really want to kill Liu Bang?

"Historical Records" records: [Xiang Bo promised and said to Pei Gong: "You must come to thank King Xiang one day." Pei Gong said: "Promise." So Xiang Bo went to the army at night and repaid King Xiang with Pei Gong's words, because he said: "If Pei Gong doesn't break the pass first, how dare you enter? It is unjust to attack a man who has great achievements. It is better to meet him for good." King Xiang promised.On the same day, Pei Gong came to see King Xiang with more than a hundred horses. When they arrived at Hongmen, they thanked him and said, "I and the general fought hard to attack Qin. The general fought in Hebei and I fought in Henan. I didn't expect to be able to enter the pass first and defeat Qin. I saw the general here again. Now I have the words of a villain, so I ordered the general and the minister to give up." King Xiang said: "This Pei Gong left Sima Cao without any regrets. Otherwise, why would I be here?"

In other words, early the next morning, before the rooster crow, Liu Bang got up early and took more than a hundred bodyguards to Hongmen to meet Xiang Yu.

As soon as they met, Liu Bang apologized to Xiang Yu: "I joined forces with the general to attack Qin. The general fought north of the Yellow River, and I provided support south of the Yellow River. I didn't expect that I was so lucky that I entered the pass first and destroyed the Qin Dynasty, and then I saw you here. I heard that you misunderstood me. There must be some villain sowing discord. Don't believe it."

After careful reflection, Liu Bang's words are profound. Professor Wang Liqun once called Liu Bang's words "Hongmen rhetoric."

First of all, Liu Bang emphasized his comradeship with Xiang Yu, eliminated Xiang Yu's hostility towards him, and showed that he and Xiang Yu were both the two main forces in the anti-Qin uprising, and they were in an alliance.

Secondly, Liu Bang denied his intention to enter Guanzhong first and wanted to be the king of Guanzhong. He explained that he entered Guanzhong by accident and changed an inevitable event into an accident. Therefore, there is no so-called rumor of "desiring to be the king of Guanzhong".

Since Emperor Yi made a covenant at the beginning: "First enter Guanzhong and become the king." I, Liu Bang, have no intention of "wanting to be the king of Guanzhong". Instead, I am waiting for you to accept it.So Xiang Yu is a bit out of his element if he organizes his troops and goes to war like this.But it doesn't matter, because Liu Bang has already found a way for Xiang Yu. "Now there are villains who are causing trouble" and destroy the unity between me and you, general.In a word: misunderstandings are all misunderstandings.

Liu Bang spoke in a neither humble nor arrogant manner, and was a little aggrieved in his flattery.Now that the words had come to this point, Xiang Yu had to express his position. He said to Liu Bang: "That's right. This is what your subordinate Cao Wushang said. Otherwise I wouldn't be so angry. Okay, let's go and have a drink together."

It can be seen from this that Xiang Yu is indeed very face-saving. I am now the leader of the Qin Dynasty and the greatest hero in the world. As the boss, if I don't distinguish between right and wrong and I don't know what's going on, won't I let the princes of the world see me clearly?They think that I am neither benevolent nor righteous and have no political wisdom.So, Cao Wushang was sold to Cao Wushang with just one word.

In Xiang Yu's eyes, Cao Wushang was nothing more than an unfaithful and unjust villain. This kind of person failed more than succeeded, and there was no need to protect him.

But this explanation is really unnecessary. At this time, Xiang Yu had 400,000 troops. It was the most glorious time of his life. Faced with Liu Bang's begging, he could just laugh it off and continue to manipulate Liu Bang. After all, a sturdy life does not need explanation.But Xiang Yu always felt that he couldn't save face, so he explained it seriously.With this explanation, Xiang Yu was already at a disadvantage.

In the big tent, everyone's seats are clearly arranged.Xiang Yu is the host, sitting with Xiang Bo facing east; Fan Zeng is sitting facing south; Liu Bang is the guest, sitting facing north; Zhang Liang is accompanying him facing west.Everyone in the tent had their own thoughts.

Zhang Liang did not drink and silently watched Xiang Yu's every move.Fan Zeng squinted and stared at Liu Bang opposite.Liu Bang clearly felt the strong murderous aura emanating from Fan Zeng.However, he acted calmly and repeatedly raised his glass to toast Xiang Yu who was sitting on the west side, recalling the glorious days of the revolution when the two fought side by side.

Xiang Yu's face is a bit stern, with a majestic Chinese character face, under two thick eyebrows, a pair of tiger eyes gleaming, with a formidable aura, not angry but powerful.Facing Liu Bang's sincere greetings, Xiang Yu responded to Liu Bang's compliments and praises, his brows furrowed and his face uncertain.

When Fan Zeng saw Xiang Yu's posture, his tone, and his eyes, there was no murderous intent. Are all my previous words in vain?This is not possible!Xiang Yu must be reminded to kill Liu Bang.Fan Zeng kept winking at Xiang Yu, but when he didn't respond, he raised the jade he was wearing to signal him.

Xiang Yu's reaction?He pretended not to see it.

Fan Zeng felt a surge of anger in his heart and thought to himself: "Liu Bang must not be able to leave here alive! Since King Xiang is so indecisive and has a womanly heart to let Liu Bang go, then let me be the bad guy."
